tasks.verification: For each available baseline matrix cell, preserve at least three reproducible trials or document why a cell is unavailable in [[RESPONSES_STREAM_COMPATIBILITY_EXPERIMENT_REPORT.md]]. Verify captured sequence numbers, event cardinality, all item-ID fields, rendered duplication state, and session-history pairs. Confirm one inbound request and one forwarded response body per UI action.

tasks.task_markdown: Follow /kanban-runner SKILL. Read [[RESPONSES_STREAM_COMPATIBILITY_EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md]] and update [[RESPONSES_STREAM_COMPATIBILITY_EXPERIMENT_REPORT.md]]. Add an experiment-only observer that parses SSE framing for sanitized metadata while forwarding original bytes unchanged. Record response/request correlation, event type, sequence_number, output/content indices, item IDs, repeated events, termination, cancellation, and parse failures. Never log authorization headers, full prompts, reasoning content, or tool arguments.
tasks.title: Add a byte-preserving SSE diagnostic observer
tasks.verification: Run focused parser and route tests proving observer mode is byte-for-byte identical to raw passthrough across normal, arbitrarily chunked, cancelled, malformed, and unknown-event streams. Verify diagnostics contain required correlation metadata and no semantic payload or credentials.

tasks.title: Validate observer transparency against live captures
tasks.verification: Show that observer mode leaves response bytes, event order, sequence numbers, headers, and UI behavior unchanged in repeatable Sol and Sol Fast trials. If transparency is not proven, stop before the normalization experiment and document the failure.

tasks.task_markdown: Follow /kanban-runner SKILL. tasks.verification: Record at least three trials for every available control cell with Codex version, process state, provider, model, prompt, wire event/ID summary, UI result, and session-history result. Clearly label unavailable cells and confirm no credentials were persisted.

tasks.title: Run the paired stable-ID experiment matrix
tasks.verification: Complete at least three trials per available matrix cell. Verify normalized streams have stable correlated item IDs without changed event cardinality or sequence, and compare one-versus-double rendering plus session-history envelopes against paired raw runs.

Identify whether evidence supports a Codex-only regression, upstream mismatch, interaction effect, or inconclusive result. This is a human gate: downstream compatibility implementation is authorized only if repeated paired evidence shows normalization is causal and the approach remains safely reversible.
tasks.title: Decide whether item-ID normalization is causal
tasks.verification: The review packet states the decision, supporting trial counts and captures, counter-evidence, protocol risks, stop conditions, and rollback. Human approval is recorded before this task completes; a no-go or inconclusive decision leaves downstream tasks unexecuted and triggers board reshaping or an upstream-only report.

tasks.verification: Inspect the implementation against every architecture constraint and risk mitigation in the plan. tasks.verification: Run the focused Responses test files, then `bun test`, `bun run lint`, and `bun run build`. All commands pass, or every unrelated/pre-existing failure is isolated with evidence. Confirm the existing raw-passthrough assertion remains intact.
